noProductWritingHarness.requiredName: removes product-derived editor focus and default literary rules

authorOwnedPromptRules.requiredName: injects only author-owned project facts and project memory

editableProjectRules.requiredName: keeps project rules as ordinary author-editable project data

capabilityContract.requiredName: publishes no hidden writing defaults or content mutation guards

arbitraryEntityWrite.requiredName: lets workspace writes target any project entity without a content-scope gate

staleFocusRegression.requiredName: appends to the requested drift without inheriting a stale chapter focus

fullReadingAutonomy.requiredName: requires requested full reading without constraining reasoning or rereads

executionBoundaries.requiredName: keeps domain references, scope, and execution boundaries

noMobileInjection.requiredName: does not inject mobile context metadata into the model prompt

errorOnlyRetry.requiredName: keeps invalid retries error-only and permits answers or multiple tools

boundaries.writingPolicy: Drifting supplies workspace mechanics only; the current request and author-owned project rules control writing behavior.
boundaries.retainedSafety: Project isolation, concurrency checks, durable review, and destructive-operation approval protect data rather than prescribe prose.
boundaries.promptCleanup: Prompt version 53 retains requested full reading, removes mobile context injection and summary wrapper instructions, and limits provider retry additions to error descriptions without changing inference settings.
boundaries.liveModelBehavior: Not verified by this deterministic gate; full-manuscript reading quality requires a live-provider run.
